bugs.name: Dashboard menu actions reload the page
bugs.summary: Choosing Move, Duplicate or Move to trash from a dashboard's menu reloads the whole page
bugs.expected: The action opens its modal in place, without a full page reload.
bugs.actual: These menu items now render as plain links, so the browser does a full page reload before the modal opens.
reproSteps: Open the dashboard's ... menu and choose Move, Duplicate or Move to trash.
Watch whether the browser reloads the page before the modal appears.
